## About
Grand Prix Auto Body is a body shop on Mateo St in Downtown LA, a stone's throw from the art district and easy to reach from the freeway. We handle everything from scratches, scuffs and dents to damage from collisions and major accidents, along with full paint jobs and basic mechanical work.
We treat each car like it's our own: careful repairs, the best paints on the market, and patience with every detail. We've worked on everything from Kia to Ferrari, and most of our customers are repeat customers.
Owner Scott Han and co-owner Jake Han run the shop, and we can help you in English, Spanish and Korean. Call us with questions or stop in after a fender bender.

## Services
- Scratches, dents and collision damage: From scratches, scuffs and dents up to damage from collisions and major accidents.
- Full paint jobs: Full paint jobs, wheels, moldings, or any part of your car that needs paint work.
- Oil changes and basic maintenance: Oil changes, basic maintenance and repairs.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're in Downtown LA, a stone's throw from the art district and easy to reach from the 10 freeway.

Q: What languages do you speak?
A: We can help you in English, Spanish and Korean.
